create_continuous_simulator: create a ContinuousSoundSpacesSim instance with habitat config for audio-enabled 3D simulation
reset_simulator_episode: reset the ContinuousSoundSpacesSim episode and return initial sensor observations
step_simulator: step the ContinuousSoundSpacesSim with an action and return updated sensor observations
compute_audiogoal_observation: compute the current audiogoal observation by convolving source sound with binaural RIR
get_straight_shortest_path_points: get the straight shortest path points between two positions using the simulator pathfinder
